# 2 Baruch Chapter 79 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** Baruch's Letters

---

**1** "Do not be distressed by what has happened to you — by the fact that the enemy has overcome you. This came upon you as discipline because of your sins."

**2** "But if you turn away from your evil ways and correct your behavior, you will once again be rescued by the hand of the Mighty One."

**3** "He in whom you have hoped is merciful; he is good to those who return to him; he bears witness to all his deeds, and he will judge every creature he has made with righteousness."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
